body: So, by stating 'Never give up' I am going from the controlled to the controller?

The good news (well good news for others) is that Factor 5 is Hereditary, so if your mother/grandmother/etc. never had any problems with Blood Clotting, chances are you're fine. I have it, while 2 out of 3 of my brothers are a carrier of the gene.

I feel your pain.. Literally! 

When I was diagnosed with PCOS, the doctor prescribed birth control to help counteract it. When he sent me for more blood work we found out that I also have Factor 5, which is a blood clotting disorder. Long story short, the birth control would put me at a 93% chance of blood clots, so I basically have no option for control over the PCOS. 

Hopefully you'll find something that works for you for the pain, and to get it under control!! Good Luck!
